summary_1line: Vasishtha explains that ignorance binds the pure Self to cycles of birth through Prakriti, while true understanding of scripture reveals the path to emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: The soul is depicted like the moon waxing and waning across the sky, while an unseen constant lunar core shines behind the changing phases.
A radiant pure soul stands untouched at the center while fifteen surrounding elements—senses and mind—form shifting layers around it.
Sage Vasishtha sits calmly before King Janaka in a forest hermitage, explaining the mystery of liberation while the king listens intently.
